# vaulted-null_decrypt (Ephemeral Resource)

Ephemeral resource to decrypt vaulted content. The decrypted result is available during the Terraform run but is not stored in state for security.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The encrypted content (vaulted format) to decrypt

### Read-Only

- `decrypted` (String, Sensitive) The decrypted plaintext content
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
